events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Researcher is in Microsoft Word
events.titleJa: 研究者は Microsoft Word を使用しています
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Researcher is in Microsoft Word
events.summary: The Researcher agent now has easier entry points on the Word canvas —making it faster to go from idea to polished research report without breaking your flow.

events.summaryEn: The Researcher agent now has easier entry points on the Word canvas —making it faster to go from idea to polished research report without breaking your flow.
